ei.title: Christine and Leo at the Vet

fullPassage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. She desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible. The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo’s turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently examined him. The vet said, “I think Leo has a minor infection.” “Infection? Will he be okay?” asked Christine. “We need to do some tests to see if he is infected. But for the tests, it’s best for Leo to stay here,” replied the vet. It was heartbreaking for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but she had to accept it was for the best. “I’ll call you with updates as soon as we know anything,” said the vet. Throughout the day, Christine anxiously awaited news about Leo. Later that day, the phone rang and it was the vet. “The tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he’ll be back to his playful self soon.” Relieved to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo. The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal. She patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time. As the days passed, Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit.

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner __________ loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 선행사 a cat owner(사람)를 수식하고 뒤에 동사 loved가 오므로 주격 관계대명사 who가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① who: 사람 선행사 + 주격 관계대명사
❌ ② which: 사물 선행사용
❌ ③ whom: 목적격 → 뒤에 주어+동사가 와야 함
❌ ④ what: 선행사 포함 관계대명사 → 앞에 선행사가 있으면 불가
det.tip: 사람 선행사 + 주격 = who / 사물 선행사 + 주격 = which

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. __________ for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Christine이 걱정을 느끼는 주체이므로 감정 분사 Concerned(과거분사)가 적절하다. 분사구문으로 이유를 나타낸다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② Concerned: 감정 분사(과거분사) → "걱정되어" (이유의 분사구문)
❌ ① Concerning: "~에 관하여" 또는 "걱정시키는" → 의미 부적절
❌ ③ To concern: to부정사는 이유 표현에 어색
❌ ④ Having concerned: concern은 타동사로 "걱정시키다" → 의미 반대
det.tip: 감정동사 분사: 감정을 느끼는 주체 = 과거분사(concerned, surprised) / 감정을 유발하는 대상 = 현재분사(concerning, surprising)

questions.passage: __________ she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. She desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: "항상 이 병원에 데려왔으므로" 수의사가 Leo를 잘 안다고 확신 → 이유의 접속사 As가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ As: 이유(~이므로) → 뒤 절과 인과 관계
❌ ① Although(비록 ~이지만): 양보 → 인과 관계와 반대
❌ ② Despite(~에도 불구하고): 전치사 → 뒤에 절 불가
❌ ④ Unless(~하지 않으면): 조건 → 문맥과 무관
det.tip: As = 이유(~이므로) / 시간(~할 때) / 비례(~함에 따라) — 문맥에 따라 의미 구분

questions.passage: It was __________ for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but she had to accept it was for the best.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: "It was __ for A to V" 가주어 구문에서 보어 자리에 형용사 heartbreaking이 적절하다. 상황이 "가슴 아프게 하는" 것이므로 현재분사형 형용사.
det.analysis:
✅ ① heartbreaking: "It is + 형용사 + for A + to V" 구문 → 상황의 성질을 나타내는 형용사
❌ ② heartbreakingly: 부사 → 보어 자리에 부적절
❌ ③ heartbreak: 명사 → was 뒤 보어로 어색
❌ ④ heartbroken: "가슴이 찢어진" → 사람의 감정 상태(Christine is heartbroken)에 쓰임, It 가주어 구문에 부적절
det.tip: It is heartbreaking to V = ~하는 것은 가슴 아프다 (상황 묘사 → -ing형 형용사)

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. She desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible. The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo’s turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently ①<u>examined</u> him. The vet said, “I think Leo has a minor infection.” “We need to do some tests to see if he is ②<u>infected</u>. But for the tests, it’s best for Leo to stay here,” replied the vet. Relieved to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to ③<u>picking</u> up Leo.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~③ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은? (번호는 지문 등장 순서)

det.korean: ③ picking → pick: to부정사(to + 동사원형) 구조에서 동사원형 pick이 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ picking: to pick up(데리러 가다) → to 뒤에 동사원형 필요
✅ ① examined: watched as the vet examined → 과거형 올바름
✅ ② infected: if he is infected → 수동태 올바름
det.tip: to + 동사원형: to pick up(데리러 가다) — to 뒤에 -ing형 불가

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: "I think Leo has a minor infection." → 수의사가 가벼운 감염이라고 말했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 수의사는 Leo에게 가벼운 감염이 있다고 말했다: 원문 일치
❌ ① "she always brought Leo to this hospital" → 처음이 아님
❌ ③ "it’s best for Leo to stay here" → 병원에 머물렀음
❌ ④ "the phone rang and it was the vet" → 전화를 받았음
det.tip: 내용 일치: 선택지의 키워드를 본문과 하나씩 대조하기

ch: Christine은 처음으로 그 동물병원에 Leo를 데려갔다.
수의사는 Leo에게 가벼운 감염이 있다고 말했다.
Leo는 검사를 받기 위해 집에 머물렀다.

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 수의사는 "minor infection"이라고 했고 약과 휴식이 필요하다고 했지, 수술이 필요하다고 하지 않았다.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ 심각한 수술 필요: 원문은 minor infection + medication and rest → 수술 언급 없음
✅ ① "desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care" → 일치
✅ ② "The waiting room was filled with other pet owners" → 일치
✅ ④ "Leo gradually regained his strength" → 일치
det.tip: 불일치 문제: 본문에 없는 내용이나 왜곡된 내용을 찾기

ch: Christine은 Leo의 빠른 치료를 간절히 바랐다.
수의사는 Leo가 심각한 수술이 필요하다고 말했다.

questions.passage:
(A) Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. She desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible.

(B) “I’ll call you with updates as soon as we know anything,” said the vet. Throughout the day, Christine anxiously awaited news about Leo. Later that day, the phone rang and it was the vet. “The tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he’ll be back to his playful self soon.” Relieved to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo.

(C) The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal. She patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time. As the days passed, Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit.

(D) The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo’s turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently examined him. The vet said, “I think Leo has a minor infection.” “Infection? Will he be okay?” asked Christine. “We need to do some tests to see if he is infected. But for the tests, it’s best for Leo to stay here,” replied the vet. It was heartbreaking for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but she had to accept it was for the best.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 (A)에 이어질 내용을 순서에 맞게 배열한 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 병원 방문 → (D) 대기/진찰/검사 필요 → (B) 전화 결과/데리러 감 → (C) 약 투여/집 회복. 정답: (D)-(B)-(C)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ (D)-(B)-(C): 시간 순서로 자연스러운 흐름
❌ ① (B)-(D)-(C): 전화가 진찰보다 먼저 올 수 없음
❌ ② (C)-(B)-(D): 회복이 진찰보다 먼저 올 수 없음
❌ ③ (C)-(D)-(B): 회복이 가장 먼저 올 수 없음
❌ ⑤ (D)-(C)-(B): 약 투여가 결과 통보보다 먼저 올 수 없음
det.tip: 순서배열: (D)의 "tests"가 (B)의 "The tests revealed"로 연결되는 단서를 확인

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem: 이 글에서 Christine의 심경 변화로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Leo가 아파서 걱정(worried) → 좋은 소식에 안도(relieved) → 회복을 돌보며 감사(grateful)
det.analysis:
✅ ① worried → relieved → grateful: "Concerned" → "Relieved to hear" → "love and attention"으로 돌봄
❌ ② indifferent: "Concerned"와 반대
❌ ③ excited: 아픈 고양이에 들뜨지 않음
❌ ④ calm: "desperately", "anxiously"와 반대
det.tip: 심경 변화: Concerned/desperately(걱정) → Relieved(안도) → patted with love(감사/사랑)

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. She __________ hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사랑하는 고양이가 아프니 간절히(desperately) 치료를 바랐다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ desperately(간절히): "Concerned" + "as soon as possible"과 자연스럽게 연결
❌ ① reluctantly(마지못해): 반대 감정
❌ ② indifferently(무관심하게): 반대 감정
❌ ③ casually(무심하게): 반대 감정
det.tip: desperately hoped = 간절히 바랐다 — 걱정과 급박함의 맥락

questions.passage: The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo’s turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently __________ him. The vet said, “I think Leo has a minor infection.”
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수의사가 Leo를 부드럽게 진찰했다(examined).
det.analysis:
✅ ② examined(진찰했다): "gently" + 수의사가 진단을 내리기 전 진찰하는 맥락
❌ ① ignored(무시했다): 반대
❌ ③ released(풀어주었다): 시점 부적절
❌ ④ adopted(입양했다): 무관
det.tip: examined = 진찰하다 — 수의사(vet) + gently + 진단(minor infection)과 자연스러운 연결

questions.passage: “The tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he’ll be back to his playful self soon.” __________ to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 곧 회복될 거라는 좋은 소식을 듣고 안도하여(Relieved) 달려갔다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ Relieved(안도한): "back to his playful self soon" → 좋은 소식 → 안도
❌ ① Disappointed(실망한): 좋은 소식에 어울리지 않음
❌ ② Confused(혼란스러운): 맥락과 무관
❌ ④ Frustrated(좌절한): 맥락과 반대
det.tip: Relieved to hear = ~을 듣고 안도한 — 긍정적 소식 + rushed to pick up

questions.passage: The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy __________. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빠른 회복(recovery)을 위한 팁을 공유했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① recovery(회복): "administer medication" + "rest and heal"과 자연스러운 연결
❌ ② surgery(수술): 언급 없음
❌ ③ adoption(입양): 무관
❌ ④ separation(분리): 무관
det.tip: speedy recovery = 빠른 회복 — medication + rest and heal 맥락

questions.passage: Back at home, Christine created a __________ (comfort) space for Leo to rest and heal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: comfort(명사) → comfortable(형용사): 명사 space를 수식하는 형용사 필요
det.analysis:
comfort(명사) → comfortable(형용사)
a + 형용사 + space → a comfortable space = 편안한 공간
det.tip: comfort → comfortable(형용사) / comfortably(부사) — 명사 수식 = 형용사

questions.passage: The vet said, “I think Leo has a minor __________. (infect)”
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: infect(동사) → infection(명사): a minor 뒤에 명사가 필요
det.analysis:
infect(동사) → infection(명사)
관사 a + 형용사 minor + 명사 → a minor infection
det.tip: infect → infection(명사) / infected(형용사) — 관사+형용사 뒤 = 명사

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 Christine이 Leo를 데려간 장소를 본문에서 2단어로 찾아 쓰시오.

det.korean: "Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital" → 동물병원
det.analysis: take him to the animal hospital → Leo를 데려간 장소 = animal hospital
det.tip: 본문에서 찾아쓰기: 장소를 묻는 질문 → 전치사 to 뒤의 명사구 확인

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 Christine이 Leo를 병원에 남겨두는 것을 받아들인 이유를 나타내는 3단어 표현을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.

det.korean: "she had to accept it was for the best" → 최선이라서 받아들였다
det.analysis:
accept it was for the best → "최선을 위해서"라는 의미
for the best = 결국 가장 좋은 것을 위해
det.tip: for the best = 최선을 위해 — "accept + it was for the best" 구문

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"Christine always brought Leo to the same animal hospital."

det.korean: "As she always brought Leo to this hospital" → Christine은 항상 같은 동물병원에 Leo를 데려갔다. → True
det.analysis: ✅ True: 원문 "she always brought Leo to this hospital"과 일치
det.tip: T/F: "always"와 "same"을 본문의 "always" + "this hospital"과 대조

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"The vet immediately called Christine with the test results the same morning."

det.korean: 본문: "Throughout the day, Christine anxiously awaited" + "Later that day, the phone rang" → 같은 날 오후에 전화가 왔지, 같은 날 아침에 바로 전화한 것이 아니다. → False
det.analysis: ❌ False: "Later that day"이지 "the same morning"이 아님. "Throughout the day"는 하루 종일 기다렸다는 뜻
det.tip: 시간 표현 주의: immediately + the same morning ≠ Later that day(그날 나중에)

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"Leo gradually recovered his strength after Christine took care of him at home."

det.korean: "As the days passed, Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit." → Leo는 집에서 Christine의 돌봄 후 기력을 회복했다. → True
det.analysis: ✅ True: "Back at home" + "Leo gradually regained his strength"과 일치
det.tip: recovered = regained → 동의어 관계 확인. "at home" 정보도 본문과 일치
